definition.simple: A period when price moves sideways in a fairly narrow box, often after a bigger move.
definition.balanced: Highs stop rising and lows stop falling. You can measure the box against [[atr|ATR]] to see how narrow it is. A consolidation can end with a [[breakout]] in either direction, or last much longer than expected.

example: Highs near 82.40 and lows near 80.10 for 30 candles, with ATR 1.10: a box about 2.1 ATR tall.
